name: Happy Path — Cash ISA Opening and Initial Deposit
description: Existing customer opens a Cash ISA via mobile app. Passes eligibility check. KYC current. Application submitted. ISA account created. £5,000 initial deposit from current account. ISA subscription updated. Confirmation dispatched.

steps.action: Browse savings products → select Cash ISA
GET /savings/isa-eligibility
200 OK {eligible: true, subscription_remaining: '20000.00', tax_year: '2026/2027'}
Display Cash ISA: AER 4.5%, FSCS protected, £20,000 remaining allowance
Complete ISA declaration + NI number + confirm SCA
POST /sca/validate {assertion}
200 OK {valid: true}
POST /savings/accounts {product_id, isa_declaration_confirmed: true, national_insurance_number, initial_deposit_amount: '5000.00', initial_deposit_source_account_id}
Check KYC status for customer_id (SVC-001 calls SVC-014 — both within CAP-001 context, or via platform check)
KYC current — no new verification required
Publish SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted (EVT-148)
Consume EVT-148 → Set up AML monitoring for new savings relationship
Create SavingsAccount (account_number, sort_code, status=active) + IsaSubscriptionRecord (tax_year=2026/2027, subscription_used=0)
Publish SavingsAccountOpened (EVT-149) {account_id, account_number, is_isa_wrapper: true, tax_year}
Consume EVT-149 → Record for FSCS reporting and HMRC ISA notification queue
201 Created {account_id, account_number, sort_code, isa_subscription_remaining: '20000.00'}
Process internal transfer: debit current account by £5,000; credit ISA savings account
Update IsaSubscriptionRecord: subscription_used = 5000.00, subscription_remaining = 15000.00
Publish IsaSubscriptionUpdated (EVT-150) {subscription_used: '5000.00', subscription_remaining: '15000.00'}
Publish SavingsDepositMade (EVT-151) {deposit_amount: '5000.00', new_balance: '5000.00'}
Consume EVT-149 → Dispatch Cash ISA opening confirmation: account number, AER 4.5%, FSCS protected, £15,000 remaining allowance
Consume EVT-149 + EVT-150 → Write immutable audit records (HMRC/FSCS)
